## Purpose

This chapter is the operational route from an authorised REDCap release to the Info-Hub. It is designed to be followed by an analyst. Detailed dialog fields, commands, file locations and troubleshooting remain in the [Technical Manual](../../technical/workflows/overview.qmd).

## The tools and their jobs

| Tool | Operational role |
|---|---|
| **REDCap** | Holds the authoritative event records and their corrections. |
| **Stata** | Extracts, prepares and analyses data; creates review packages; records approval; promotes approved analytical products. |
| **VS Code** | Edits Quarto narrative and website source and shows the Git changes proposed for publication. |
| **Quarto** | Renders the approved website presentation and downloads catalogue. |
| **GitHub** | Records reviewed public changes and deploys the static Info-Hub. |

## One preparation layer, three reporting pathways

Dashboard Steps 1–3, accessed in Stata through **User > BNR > Update dashboard**, form the common analytical preparation layer. Step 3 creates the private deidentified inputs used by all three reporting pathways.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A["Authorised REDCap release"] --> B["Stata: Dashboard Steps 1–3"]
    B --> C["Dashboard Steps 4–6"]
    B --> D["Tabulation Steps 1–3"]
    B --> E["Briefing Steps 1–3"]
    C --> F["Approved public products"]
    D --> F
    E --> F
    F --> G["VS Code + Quarto + GitHub"]
```

## Rules common to every pathway

1. Use the same release year, month and package identity throughout.
2. Keep source data, logs, staging packages and review files in the private workspace.
3. Inspect quality, method, plausibility and disclosure risk before approval.
4. Approve the exact reviewed package through the relevant Stata step.
5. Use the controlled Stata publication step; do not copy individual output files by hand.
6. Update Quarto content only from the approved website mirror.
7. Render and inspect the site before committing and pushing public changes.

Stop when the source period, package identity, result, disclosure status or approval is unclear. Correct the authoritative REDCap record or version-controlled code, then rerun from the earliest affected stage.
